lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdAuPd crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—Nd4Au4Pd4—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Au, Nd, and Pd centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom. The Au and Nd coordination polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces, while Au–Pd and Nd–Pd polyhedra share corners and edges, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
